verdict.rationale: uv's docs say it uses aggressive caching to avoid re-downloading and re-building dependencies already accessed in prior runs, backed by a global deduplicating cache (uv-docs-25, uv-docs-33). That directly covers installing built artifacts from cache rather than recompiling. A user report of `--no-binary` not being sticky implies binary installs are the default (uv-comm-14), and a hands-on report of fast pytorch installs supports the speed claim (uv-comm-13). One user saw uvx occasionally re-download dependencies across tools (uv-comm-10), which tempers confidence but does not contradict the build cache. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of prebuilt wheel selection and of how built-wheel caching works, and independent verification that source builds are skipped on cache hits.
